Plan 010 F001 dispatch surfaced 4 candidates: D005 (quota_caps doctor surface), D007 (prompt-template token bloat 6.84M for 763 lines), D008 (no_progress taxonomy [unknown] on documentation finding), D009 (signoff close-out workflow gap). title: F003 spec_ambiguity is non-blocking (advisory), not lower-friction-blocking
body: Open question from F003 step 4: should spec_ambiguity be non-blocking or just lower-friction-blocking? Decided non-blocking. Rationale: (a) the motivating case (plan 010 F001 iter1 — PP version pin documentation placement) was operator-resolved without any spec patch — the implementer's reading was accepted as-is; treating it as blocking would have forced a manual breaker clear for a finding the operator was always going to wave through; (b) the gate is narrow enough — severity ∈ {low,medium} AND category ∈ {documentation, naming, convention, placement} — that high-severity / correctness / security findings still route to implementation_defect via the substantive-severity heuristic ahead of the spec_ambiguity gate; (c) the recommended_action template names BOTH paths (patch the spec then resume OR accept the implementer's reading) so the operator sees the trade-off inline; (d) F004 (operator-resolved close-out workflow) makes the accept-and-close path one-command, which lowers the cost of advisory misclassifications further. Trade-off: a real defect mis-categorized as 'documentation' by the auditor would now skip the breaker. Mitigated by the severity gate — auditors that flag a real defect as severity=high will still hit implementation_defect.

title: F003 ordered AFTER evidence_shape gate, BEFORE substantive-severity fallback
body: Pipeline order in classify_finding: scope_overreach → env_repro → evidence_shape (saved-evidence-gated) → spec_ambiguity (new) → substantive-severity defect → unknown. Placed spec_ambiguity after evidence_shape so a documentation finding whose dispute is the evidence FORMAT (with saved equivalent evidence on disk) still routes to evidence_shape_disagreement — preserves the existing test_evidence_shape_with_saved_evidence_flips contract. Placed before the substantive-severity fallback so low/medium documentation findings (the gap) flip to spec_ambiguity instead of falling through to UNKNOWN. _aggregate priority adds SPEC_AMBIGUITY at the end of the advisory tier (UNKNOWN > IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT > SCOPE_OVERREACH > ENV_REPRO > EVIDENCE_SHAPE > SPEC_AMBIGUITY) so a mixed terminal with any defect/unknown still elevates to blocking.
